localHighlights.title: Valbona to Theth Trek
localHighlights.description: Trek the famous Valbona to Theth trail—our recommended route for the best experience. We organize all your transport and securely store your luggage for free. To Valbona: 6:30am (from hostel). Return from Theth: 11:00am/5:00pm (Jezerca Market).
localHighlights.alt: Hiking in the Albanian Alps near Theth and Valbona

localHighlights.title: Shala River Day Trip
localHighlights.description: Known as the 'Thailand of Albania', the Shala River features crystal-clear water tucked between steep mountain peaks. The day trip includes the scenic boat ride from Komani and we'll help you organize the departure right from the hostel. Bus departs 6:30am in front of hostel.
localHighlights.alt: Crystal clear water at the Shala River in Northern Albania

localHighlights.title: Komani Lake Boat Tour
localHighlights.description: Experience one of the world's most beautiful boat journeys. This spectacular route winds through narrow mountain passages and vertical cliffs on turquoise waters. The full tour includes the scenic ferry ride and return transport. Bus departs 6:30am in front of hostel.
localHighlights.alt: Scenic boat tour on Komani Lake, Albania

localHighlights.title: Rozafa Castle
localHighlights.description: The city's top attraction. Perched on a rocky hill with beautiful views across Lake Shkodër and three rivers. Best visited an hour before sunset for the golden lighting across the valleys.
localHighlights.alt: View from Rozafa Castle in Shkoder

localHighlights.title: The Pedestrian Street (Kolë Idromeno)
localHighlights.description: The lively Venetian-style pedestrian street starting right outside the hostel! Lined with independent cafés, shops, and restaurants, it's perfect for evening promenades.
localHighlights.alt: Walking down the Pedonale in Shkoder

localHighlights.title: Lake Shkodër & Shiroka Village
localHighlights.description: The largest lake in the Balkans is a breathtaking natural wonder where dramatic karst mountains meet fields of floating water lilies. It's also a world-renowned sanctuary for over 280 bird species.
localHighlights.alt: Biking along Lake Shkoder towards Shiroka

localHighlights.title: Mesi Bridge (The Old Bridge)
localHighlights.description: A stunning, curved Ottoman bridge resting over the shallow, opal waters of the Kir River, built in 1768 to connect the city with the northern highlands. Also a great spot for a swim!
localHighlights.alt: The historic Ottoman Mesi Bridge in Shkoder

localHighlights.title: Marubi National Photography Museum
localHighlights.description: A quiet, modern exhibition featuring over 150 years of Albanian history through the incredibly detailed lenses of the Marubi family. Just a few doors down from the hostel!
localHighlights.alt: Inside the Marubi National Photography Museum
